# Build

> Guides for renting GPU compute, CPU compute, and Cloud Agents on Fluence Cloud: the Fluence Console at console.fluence.ai, the Fluence API at api.fluence.dev, accounts, balance, and billing.

If you are new to Fluence Cloud, start with the [Overview](https://fluence.dev/docs/build/overview.md). It lists what you can rent and the ways to work with Fluence Cloud. The CPU Cloud and GPU Cloud sections each start with a concepts page about resources, statuses, and billing. The Cloud Agents section covers coding agents that run on their own machines in your account, starting with [Cloud agents concepts](https://fluence.dev/docs/build/cloud_agents/overview.md). For code, start with the [API overview](https://fluence.dev/docs/build/api/overview.md). New integrations use the Public v3, GPU v3, and Cloud Agents v3 APIs.

AI agents can fund an account over HTTP (x402 on Base or MPP on Tempo) and sign in without a human. See [Pay with x402 or MPP](https://fluence.dev/docs/build/api/x402.md). To manage CPU VMs, GPU instances, and cloud agents from an MCP client, see [Connect an AI client through MCP](https://fluence.dev/docs/build_with_ai/mcp.md).
